title: Assistants API (beta)
summary: The Assistants API beta is being removed on Aug 26, 2026. Migrate to the Responses API + Conversations API.

title: Claude Sonnet 4 & Opus 4
summary: Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4 retire June 15, 2026. Migrate to Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.8.

title: Retired Claude models (Haiku 3, 3.5/3.7 Sonnet, Claude 2.x)
summary: These Claude model IDs are already retired. Migrate to current models (Haiku 4.5 / Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.8).

title: Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash / Flash-Lite
summary: Gemini 2.5 models scheduled for shutdown Oct 16, 2026 (Google states this is the earliest possible date). Migrate to Gemini 3.x.

title: Gemini 2.0 Flash family
summary: Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash-Lite shut down June 1, 2026 (already past). Migrate to gemini-2.5-flash-lite or Gemini 3.x.

title: Gemini 1.0 / 1.5 models
summary: All Gemini 1.0 and 1.5 models are shut down and return 404. Migrate to Gemini 2.5+ or 3.x.

title: Retired GPT-4 preview/variant models
summary: These GPT-4 variant/preview models are already retired from the API and return errors: gpt-4-vision-preview (~Dec 2024), gpt-4-32k (~mid-2025), gpt-4.5-preview (July 14, 2025). Migrate to gpt-4.1 or the GPT-5 family.

title: Retired legacy OpenAI models (GPT-3 era, early snapshots)
summary: These legacy models (GPT-3-era completions and early dated GPT-4/3.5 snapshots) are already retired and return errors. Migrate to current models.

title: Removed legacy Stripe.js methods
summary: These legacy Stripe.js methods were removed and now throw errors. Replace handleCardPayment/confirmPaymentIntent with confirmCardPayment, handleCardSetup/confirmSetupIntent with confirmCardSetup, and migrate createSource/retrieveSource to the PaymentMethods API.

title: Sources API / legacy Charges API
summary: The Sources API is deprecated (local payment methods stopped being accepted May 15, 2024) and the Charges API is legacy. Migrate to the PaymentMethods + PaymentIntents APIs.

title: Notify API
summary: Twilio Notify reached end of life December 31, 2025. No 1:1 replacement — rebuild with Programmable Messaging / Conversations.

title: Programmable Chat API
summary: The standalone Programmable Chat API was sunset July 25, 2022 (Programmable Chat in Flex ended June 1, 2026). Migrate to the Conversations API.

title: twilio-chat SDK package (Programmable Chat)
summary: The twilio-chat npm package is the client SDK for the retired Programmable Chat API (sunset July 25, 2022). Remove the dependency and migrate to @twilio/conversations.

title: AWS SDK for JavaScript v2
summary: AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 (the 'aws-sdk' package) reached end-of-support Sept 8, 2025 — no more updates or security fixes. Migrate to the modular AWS SDK v3 (@aws-sdk/* packages).

title: Legacy API keys (hapikey)
summary: HubSpot deprecated legacy API keys (the hapikey query param) on Nov 30, 2022. Migrate to Private App access tokens (Bearer auth). The eCommerce Bridge and Accounting Extension APIs were also sunset Dec 1, 2022.

title: Legacy openai-python v0 call syntax
summary: openai-python v1.0 (Nov 2023) removed module-level calls. openai.ChatCompletion/Completion/Embedding.create now raise APIRemovedInV1. Instantiate a client (client = OpenAI(); client.chat.completions.create(...)) or run `openai migrate`.

title: AI SDK APIs removed in v5
summary: Removed in AI SDK v5. Import paths: 'ai/react' → '@ai-sdk/react', 'ai/rsc' → '@ai-sdk/rsc', '@ai-sdk/ui-utils' folded into 'ai'. Removed APIs: StreamData, useAssistant, ToolExecutionError; the data-stream helpers (createDataStream, createDataStreamResponse, formatDataStreamPart, processDataStream, DataStreamToSSETransformStream); and the result methods toDataStreamResponse / pipeDataStreamToResponse (now toUIMessageStreamResponse / pipeUIMessageStreamToResponse). LangChainAdapter / LlamaIndexAdapter moved to @ai-sdk/langchain and @ai-sdk/llamaindex. StreamingTextResponse and the experimental_streamText/generateText prefixes predate v5.

title: Legacy LangChain imports & chains
summary: Pre-0.2 LangChain imports are deprecated/removed: langchain.llms/chat_models/embeddings → langchain_community or provider packages (langchain_openai). LLMChain and initialize_agent are deprecated (use LCEL / create_agent; legacy moved to langchain-classic in 1.0).

title: Audiences API (deprecated in favor of Segments)
summary: Resend's Audiences API is deprecated in favor of Segments. The endpoints still work but will be removed in the future (no date announced). Migrate the audiences.* calls to the Segments API.

title: <RedirectToUserProfile /> control component deprecated
summary: Clerk's <RedirectToUserProfile /> control component is deprecated in favor of the redirectToUserProfile() method on the Clerk object. No removal date announced.

title: OpenAI models shut down July 23, 2026 (audio/search/realtime previews, deep research)
summary: These OpenAI model snapshots (audio/search/realtime previews, computer-use preview, and the deep research models) shut down in the API on July 23, 2026. Migrate to current flagship models.

title: OpenAI models shut down October 23, 2026 (legacy GPT-3.5/4/4o, GPT-4.1-nano, o1/o3-mini/o4-mini, gpt-image-1)
summary: These OpenAI models shut down in the API on October 23, 2026: GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4.1-nano, the gpt-4o-2024-05-13 snapshot, gpt-image-1, and the o1 / o1-pro / o3-mini / o4-mini reasoning models — bare aliases included, since OpenAI retires them alongside the dated snapshots. The still-current gpt-4o alias is intentionally NOT matched (only its retiring 2024-05-13 snapshot is). Migrate to the gpt-4.1 / gpt-5 family or gpt-image-1.5.

title: Realtime API beta interface removed
summary: The Realtime API beta was removed from the API on May 12, 2026. Migrate from the client.beta.realtime interface to the released (GA) Realtime API.

title: AI SDK functions/classes removed in ai v6
summary: Removed in ai v6. convertToCoreMessages → convertToModelMessages; Experimental_Agent → ToolLoopAgent; the V2 mock classes in ai/test → their V3 versions. Code using these breaks when you upgrade to ai@6.

title: generateObject / streamObject deprecated in ai v6
summary: Deprecated in ai v6 (still works; removal planned for a later version). Use generateText / streamText with an output setting (Output.object) instead.

title: Legacy recipient phone/SMS authentication (silent KBA fallback removed)
summary: DocuSign is retiring legacy recipient phone/SMS authentication (the phoneAuthentication / smsAuthentication recipient objects and idCheckConfigurationName values "Phone Auth $" / "SMS Auth $"). Enforcement also removes the legacy behavior of silently falling back to knowledge-based authentication (KBA) when phone auth fails or is unavailable — flows relying on that fallback now hard-fail. Migrate to Identity Verification phone auth (identityVerification with your account's phone-auth workflowId).

title: Experimental prompt tools APIs (generate/improve/templatize) retired with the Workbench
summary: The Claude Console's legacy Workbench is being sunset, with access ending August 17, 2026 — saved prompts, variables, and evals do not carry over to the updated Workbench, so export anything worth keeping beforehand. The experimental prompt tools endpoints (/v1/experimental/generate_prompt, /v1/experimental/improve_prompt, /v1/experimental/templatize_prompt) retire the same day; after that date they return an error, and no successor endpoint is named.

title: Customer Agent Lead Status contact property becoming read-only
summary: HubSpot made the Customer Agent Lead Status contact property (hs_customer_agent_lead_status) read-only as of Jul 13, 2026. Setting or updating this property through the Contacts API is rejected; reading it remains supported. No replacement property is named in the notice.

title: OpenAI models shut down January 20, 2027 (legacy realtime, audio, and transcription models)
summary: These OpenAI legacy audio, realtime, and transcription model families and snapshots (gpt-realtime, gpt-audio, gpt-4o-audio, gpt-4o-realtime, gpt-realtime-mini, gpt-audio-mini, gpt-4o-mini-realtime, gpt-4o-mini-audio, and the gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-03-20 snapshot) are scheduled for removal from the API on January 20, 2027. Migrate to gpt-realtime-2.1, gpt-audio-1.5, gpt-realtime-2.1-mini, or gpt-4o-mini-transcribe-2025-12-15 depending on which model is in use.

title: Claude Mythos Preview
summary: Claude Mythos Preview (claude-mythos-preview) is deprecated; no retirement date is currently announced. Migrate to Claude Mythos 5 (claude-mythos-5).

title: Fast mode removed for Claude Opus 4.7
summary: Anthropic removed fast mode for Claude Opus 4.7 on Jul 24, 2026. Requests to claude-opus-4-7 with speed: "fast" now return an error instead of silently falling back to standard speed — unlike the earlier Opus 4.6 fast-mode removal, which degraded gracefully with no error. Claude Opus 4.7 itself remains fully available at standard speed; migrate fast-mode requests to Claude Opus 4.8 or Claude Opus 5.

title: request HTTP client family (npm)
summary: The 'request' HTTP client and its request-promise wrappers were deprecated by their maintainers in Feb 2020 and receive no updates. Migrate to fetch (built into Node 18+), axios, or got.

title: Moment.js (legacy project, maintenance mode)
summary: Moment.js declares itself a legacy project in maintenance mode — no new features and no major changes planned. For new work its own docs recommend Temporal, Luxon, Day.js, or date-fns.

title: Create React App (react-scripts)
summary: Create React App was deprecated Feb 14, 2025 and is in maintenance mode. The React team recommends migrating to a framework (Next.js, React Router) or a build tool like Vite.

title: node-sass (LibSass)
summary: node-sass (LibSass) is end-of-life: no new features and no support for new Sass or CSS syntax. The 'sass' package (Dart Sass) is the drop-in replacement.

title: TSLint
summary: TSLint was deprecated in 2019 and has accepted only security fixes since Jan 2020. Migrate to ESLint with typescript-eslint.

title: Karma test runner
summary: The Karma test runner was deprecated by its maintainers in April 2023 — only critical security fixes remain. Migrate to Web Test Runner, jasmine-browser-runner, Jest, or Vitest.

title: AngularJS 1.x
summary: AngularJS (the 'angular' npm package, 1.x) reached end of life Dec 31, 2021 — no patches or security fixes since. Migrate to modern Angular or another framework.

title: Vue 2
summary: Vue 2 reached end of life Dec 31, 2023 — no features, updates, or security fixes. Migrate to Vue 3 (a migration build eases the jump).

title: ESLint v8.x
summary: ESLint v8.x reached end of life Oct 5, 2024 — no further releases in the 8.x line. Migrate to v9 and flat config.

title: distutils standard-library module
summary: The distutils module was removed from the standard library in Python 3.12 (PEP 632) — these imports fail on modern Python. Migrate to setuptools equivalents.

title: new Buffer() constructor
summary: The new Buffer() constructor is deprecated (Node.js DEP0005) — it can expose uninitialized memory. Use Buffer.alloc() or Buffer.from() instead.

title: files.upload API method
summary: Slack fully discontinued the files.upload method on Nov 12, 2025. Migrate to files.getUploadURLExternal + files.completeUploadExternal (files_upload_v2 in the Python SDK).

title: Dynamic Links
summary: Firebase Dynamic Links shut down Aug 25, 2025 — all links, including custom domains and page.link, stopped working. Remove the integration and migrate to App Links / Universal Links or a third-party provider.

title: Google Sign-In JS Platform Library (gapi.auth2)
summary: The Google Sign-In JS Platform Library is deprecated; authorization support was discontinued Mar 31, 2023 and legacy client IDs are on borrowed time. Migrate to Google Identity Services.

title: Universal Analytics (analytics.js / UA- properties)
summary: Universal Analytics shut down July 1, 2024 — properties and APIs were switched off and remaining data deleted. Tags still shipping to it collect nothing; migrate to GA4.

title: google.maps.Marker
summary: google.maps.Marker is deprecated (Feb 21, 2024): no new work, only major-regression fixes, and Google promises at least 12 months notice before discontinuing. Migrate to AdvancedMarkerElement.

title: Graph API v19 and below
summary: Graph API versions v19.0 and below are expired — requests to them return version errors under Meta's rolling ~2-year schedule. Pin a current version and plan for the next expiry.

title: Azure AD Authentication Library (ADAL)
summary: ADAL reached end of support June 30, 2023 — no security fixes since. Microsoft's replacement is MSAL (@azure/msal-node / msal for Python).

title: functions.config() runtime configuration
summary: functions.config() is deprecated: the backing Runtime Config API shut down Dec 31, 2025, CLI config commands are gone, and Firebase states deployments using it stop working in March 2027. Migrate to environment variables or parameterized configuration.

title: Protractor e2e test framework
summary: Protractor reached end of life Aug 31, 2023 — no further releases from the Angular team or community. Migrate to Cypress, Playwright, WebdriverIO, or Nightwatch.

title: Legacy Raven SDKs
summary: Sentry's Raven SDKs (raven, raven-js) are deprecated legacy clients in maintenance mode. Migrate to the unified SDKs: @sentry/browser, @sentry/node, or sentry-sdk for Python.

title: PayPal REST SDK (v1/payments)
summary: The PayPal REST SDKs are deprecated along with the v1/payments API — no new features or support, and PayPal is restricting the repos. Migrate to the current server SDKs and v2 Orders/Payments.

title: github.com/dgrijalva/jwt-go
summary: dgrijalva/jwt-go is archived (May 2022) and receives no fixes, including for security issues. The community-maintained continuation is github.com/golang-jwt/jwt.

title: github.com/golang/protobuf
summary: The github.com/golang/protobuf module is officially deprecated. Use google.golang.org/protobuf, which supersedes it with a simplified API and protobuf reflection.

title: boto (v2) Python SDK
summary: The original boto (v2) package is unmaintained and its repo was archived in May 2024 — issues and PRs are no longer reviewed. Migrate to boto3.

title: api-inference.huggingface.co endpoint
summary: The legacy api-inference.huggingface.co endpoint is no longer supported — the service itself answers requests with a migration error. Move to Inference Providers via router.huggingface.co.
